title: 10.0.3 | Bugfix Patch
body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/54c894cea91331687a3ef38d8d345c44745c4ca0.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]Killer Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]The Slasher[/b][/p][list][*][p]Jump Scare anti-camp penalty no longer applies across multiple floors[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/home/leaving?allowTrusted=1&target=https%3A%2F%2Fus.v-cdn.net%2F6030815%2Fuploads%2F8KY5KY3TXS4U%2Fbar-white.png"][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/8KY5KY3TXS4U/bar-white.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-family: inherit; color: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-size: 15.4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px; border: 0px; font-style: inherit; vertical-align: baseline; height: auto; display: block; position: relative; max-width: 100%; max-height: none; outline: 0px; width: 844px;"][/img][/url][/p][h3]Perk Updates[/h3][p][b]New Survivor Perks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cross-Examination[/p][list][*][p]While in the Killer's Terror Radius and not being chased by the Killer, they leave Light Marks that last for [b]10s [/b]that you can see. While on the Killer's Light Marks, you gain [b]Elusive[/b]. This ends after [b]3/4/5s[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/home/leaving?allowTrusted=1&target=https%3A%2F%2Fus.v-cdn.net%2F6030815%2Fuploads%2F20S1IY18G6LY%2Fbar-white.png"][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/20S1IY18G6LY/bar-white.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-family: inherit; color: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-size: 15.4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px; border: 0px; font-style: inherit; vertical-align: baseline; height: auto; display: block; position: relative; max-width: 100%; max-height: none; outline: 0px; width: 844px;"][/img][/url][/p][h3]Killer Add-on Updates[/h3][p][b]The Slasher's add-ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sauna Rock:[/p][list][*][p]After a Jump Scare, inflict all Survivors within Killer Instinct's detection range with Exhausted for [b]3[/b] [b]seconds[/b]. [i](was 13 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Two Nails:[/p][list][*][p]Spikes that come within 1 meter of a Survivor reveal their Aura for [b]5 seconds[/b]. [i](was 6 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mirror Shards:[/p][list][*][p]Impaled Survivors become Broken for [b]40 seconds[/b] after extracting the Spike. [i](was 30 seconds)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Toxic Waste:[/p][list][*][p]After a Jump Scare, Survivors within [b]10 meters[/b] of a hook or Scrap Pile gain Oblivious for 13 seconds. [i](was 8 meters)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sleeping Bag:[/p][list][*][p]After grabbing a Hook Spike while in Omnipresent Evil mode, see the locations of Survivors within [b]10 meters[/b] of hooks. [i](was 8 meters)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Party Noisemaker:[/p][list][*][p]Breaking a Pallet or Breakable Wall with Jump Scare reveals the Auras of Survivors further than [b]28 meters[/b] for 6 seconds. [i](was 32 meters)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/home/leaving?allowTrusted=1&target=https%3A%2F%2Fus.v-cdn.net%2F6030815%2Fuploads%2FTUFM04H4Q9WZ%2Fbar-red.png"][img src="https://us.v-cdn.net/6030815/uploads/TUFM04H4Q9WZ/bar-red.png" style="box-sizing: inherit; font-family: inherit; color: inherit; line-height: inherit; font-weight: inherit; font-size: 15.4px; overflow-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-word; margin: 0px auto; padding: 0px; border: 0px; font-style: inherit; vertical-align: baseline; height: auto; display: block; position: relative; max-width: 100%; max-height: none; outline: 0px; width: 844px;"][/img][/url][/p][h2][b]Summer Screams Event[/b][/h2][p]The Summer Screams event will be live from July 28th 11:00EDT - August 18th 11:00EDT. Featuring Chaos Shuffle, Lights Out and 2v8, each event will be active for 1 week at a time starting with Chaos Shuffle. Check out the available quests in order to receive rewards![/p][list][*][p]Week 1: Chaos Shuffle (July 28 - August 4)[/p][/*][*][p]Week 2: Lights Out (August 4 - August 11)[/p][/*][*][p]Week 3: 2v8 (August 11 - August 18)[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/home/leaving?allowTrusted=1&target=https%3A%2F%2Fus.v-cdn.net%2F6030815%2Fuploads%2FZZSAEJJ5K8DU%2Fbar-white.png"][img the Auras of Pallets, Vaults, and Breakable Walls within 32m[/p][/*][*][p]Gate interaction points will now remain lit once all objectives have been completed[/p][/*][*][p]Deep wounds and Anti-camp bars are now visible again[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for the Fog Vial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the lighting is inconsistent and can appear overly dark or bright on Xbox Series X[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Chaos Shuffle[/b][/p][list][*][p]All Perks and Add-ons now available to be assigned[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/home/leaving?allowTrusted=1&target=https%3A%2F%2Fus.v-cdn.net%2F6030815%2Fuploads%2FMNU28YFYT67V%2Fbar-red.png"][img max-width: 100%; max-height: none; outline: 0px; width: 844px;"][/img][/url][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]2v8[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Nemesis zombies could become stuck on Sanctum of Wrath.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Killer chests did not have their Aura revealed when facing The Nemesis and The Mastermind together.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors could see the Aura of the Cage of Corruption while in a locker.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where trapped Survivors were missing the trapped animation after stepping in The Trapper's Bear Trap while also being contaminated by The Nemesis.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a Survivor caught in a Bear Trap could be sent into a Cage of Corruption twice against The Trapper and The Mastermind.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was unable to Drop the Spray/Antidote after being used by a different Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain map specific achievements were not being awarded in correctly.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Walking Dead characters were not playing the right VO line during their interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Ice Nine Kills music wasn't playing when equipped with collection items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Slasher 'Jump Scare' cause the Survivors in Lockers to Scream.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors ''Fully Healed'' Voice line triggers when partially healed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the bananas emit a metallic sound when hit by a projectile on Trickster Delusion map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the hook voice over played too late when transitioning from phase 1 to phase 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors exit gate dialog triggered at the same time the door opens, which was making it hard to hear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the incorrect voice lines played for Killers & Survivors regardless of their language setting.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the lullaby for the Facemelter Eddie legendary cosmetic was lower than intended.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Reverted a fix that prevented The Skull Merchant from deploying Drones when above/below a Hooked Survivor.[/p][list][*][p][i]Dev Note:[/i] [i]The issue that the fix attempted to solve will be back, which made Drones disappear after being deployed, regardless of being out of the vertical range for Drone anti-camp. This is unintended and is under investigation.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where as The Animatronic, the Blighted Springtrap's Mouth Animation was unable to be seen at the end of the Killer's Mori.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where as The Dark Lord using the wolf form, the Killer could perform an extra attack right before the Pounce cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors downed by The Mastermind's vault attack while working on a Generator kept repairing while downed.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Environment/Maps[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Eyrie of Crows where the traps could not be placed properly on the second floor of the main building.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Torment Creek where traps could be placed under the ground near the window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Toba Landing where The Nurse can blink through the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Treatment Theater where The Executioner's Punishment Of The Damned attack is blocked in the middle of the main room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in Dead Dawg Saloon where The Nurse can blink on top of the small structures.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hex Statuses were hidden from Survivors when a Hex was reactivated by the Perk 'Undying'.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the perk Visionary would not reveal generator auras when exiting a Locker, after the cooldown was completed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk 'Plot Twist' could be reused when picked up or dropped by a Killer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the aura of the Perk Hex: No One Escapes Death was missing for the Survivor POV.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Deathbound caused Survivors that previously healed another Survivor to scream again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Perk Deerstalker was unable to reveal a Survivor for an additional 2 sec when equipped with the Perk Eyes of Belmont.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The perk Shadowborn failed to activate when Rampage had tokens.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Slasher's Dirty Money Add-On remained dimmed when active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Into the Fog Tooltips for Perk Related Quests did not show the associated Perk.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Oni's Blood Fury's prompt was missing an indication that it must be held to activate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivor Skills always appeared Unlocked in the Match Details screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where alternating from Chaos Shuffle to Normal Trial erased saved loadouts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where there was no HUD or UI feedback indicating The Oni's Blood Fury prompt had to be held to activate.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Misc[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Survivors were unable to wiggle when being grabbed while having a Skill Check.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing the Entity to make an illegal purchase move in the Bloodweb.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where leaving the Survivor queue in Play While You Wait would reset the Killer priority queue.[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://forums.bhvr.com/dead-by-daylight/home/leaving?allowTrusted=1&target=https%3A%2F%2Fus.v-cdn.net%2F6030815%2Fuploads%2FK19VQUWQ7BHV%2Fbar-red.png"][img facing The Doctor.[/p][list][*][p][i]Dev Note: This is unintended and will be fixed in a future release.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
